title: The Cutting Edge: Week of June 21st
body:
**Highlights**
- Parachain auctions, interoperability, dGov and unique traits of Edgeware Ecosystem were discussed by Thom Ivy, Edgeware Agency CEO in the ['EYE ON ICON' Podcast](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EgWJCG6Z-Pg&t=1s) series, an initiative by our ecosystem partner ICON Foundation.
- The [Webb and ERUP-4 AMA](https://t.me/heyedgeware/48032) with Drew Stone got a substantial amount of response.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Community members who are interested in running bridge relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members who are interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- The treasury funding proposal for [Core community dev Ramsey Ajram](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1327-edgeware-road-parachains-and-bridges-core-development) is open for public voting through Referendum 44. {Treasury Proposal ID:35, Referendum type: SimpleMajorityApprove, Council Motion ID: 50}
- The treasury funding proposal for [Exit Theory: A Content and Community Project](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1131-exit-theory-a-content-and-community-project) by Justin Murphy is open for public voting through Referendum 45. {Treasury Proposal ID:36, Referendum type: SimpleMajorityApprove, Council Motion ID: 51} 


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in,[ take a look.](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal)
